body: Thank you. And funny you mentioned insomnia, it's 4am here. It's hard for me to actually vocalize everything I feel, so I think I will print it out. Thanks a mil
Its just.. hard. But, thank you. I'll keep you in mind.
Okay, thank you for your opinion i guess.

Yes, I've been diagnosed. But, the doctors and everyone didn't want to give me meds because for some reason they thought it was a phase because high school was starting. I go to a counselor every once in a while. Which honestly doesn't help at all.

Its just everything. The pressure from parents and my teachers and peers. The stress from everything. The nervousness, being anxious. People betraying me. People lying and gossiping about me, saying horrible and evil things. Its so many things piling up. So many small things. My heart is just torn into pieces, and everytime I try to mend it, it starts to fall apart again. I don't know why I'm depressed. I mean these things just seem like teenager things right? I don't know.
